markets.question: Counter-Strike: MOUZ vs FaZe (BO3)
markets.description:
This market will resolve to "MOUZ" if MOUZ win against FaZe in the named Counter-Strike match in the StarLadder Major Budapest Playoffs, scheduled for December 12 at 11:00AM ET.

This market will resolve to "FaZe" if FaZe win against MOUZ in the Counter-Strike match.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed.

markets.question: Total Rounds Over/Under 52.5
markets.description:
In the upcoming match between FaZe and MOUZ in the StarLadder Major Budapest Playoffs, scheduled for December 12 at 2:00pm ET:

This market is about the total number of rounds in this series.

This market will resolve to "Over" if the total number of rounds across all maps in this series is greater than or equal to 53.

markets.question: MOUZ Rounds Handicap (-7.5)
markets.description:
In the upcoming match between MOUZ and FaZe in the StarLadder Major Budapest Playoffs, scheduled for December 12 at 2:00pm ET:

Otherwise, it will resolve to "FaZe".
